title: Hollow Song
author: Appropriate-Still111
selftext:
Working on an 100% AI JRPG with Roguelike elements in dungeons all you see is human direction but not one artist had to suffer yet  

It’s really challenging and I be unbearable as a game director for a team but lucky enough the ai does not complain

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
I like the layout of the interface. 

  
um 

like, how does that gun work? if a character in your world were trying to explain to me how that gun works, would they be able to?

replies.author: Appropriate-Still111
replies.body:
You nailed the main question and this is how the story starts and what’s to discover :)

nobody in this world has a clue how it works—including the guy holding it. Everyone else is terrified of it as 'Dead Iron' because they believe the gunsmoke devours your memory, while our amnesiac protagonist only knows how to shoot and reload out of pure, unexplained muscle memory.
